entities.summary: János Teleszky was a Hungarian politician, who served as Minister of Finance between 1912 and 1917. He was full member of the Hungarian Academy of Sciences. After the First World War he served as chairman of the National Financial Council. The creating of the superannuation act and formation of the Pénzintézeti Központ are connected his name.

entities.summary: János Teleszky was a Hungarian politician, who served as Minister of Finance between 1912 and 1917. He was full member of the Hungarian Academy of Sciences. After the First World War he served as chairman of the National Financial Council. The creating of the superannuation act and formation of the Pénzintézeti Központ are connected his name.
